entries.title: Three-Minute Rain Temple Swordfight
entries.text:
生成一段完整连续的3分钟写实古装武打电影片段。横屏16:9，2.35:1电影宽银幕构图，24fps，4K电影质感，冷峻低饱和蓝灰色调，真实物理动作，凌厉但克制的写实武侠风格。动作设计强调力量、速度、重心、惯性和空间利用，不使用仙术、轻功飞行或夸张能量特效。
故事发生在暴雨深夜的一座废弃山寺。青石庭院积满雨水，屋檐不断滴水，破损灯笼在风中摇晃，暖黄色火光与冷蓝色月光形成强烈对比。男主约三十岁，黑发高束，穿深靛蓝色窄袖短袍、黑色长裤和旧皮护腕，身形精悍，神情冷静，右手握一把带有磨损痕迹的窄刃长刀。二十余名蒙面敌人穿统一黑色夜行衣，从山门、回廊和屋顶逐渐包围男主，分别使用短刀、长枪、铁棍和锁链。所有人物外形、服装、兵器、伤势和位置前后保持一致，敌人数量随着战斗逐渐减少，不得凭空增加。
0-15秒：暴雨中的山寺全景，镜头穿过密集雨幕缓慢下降，越过残破屋檐和摇晃灯笼，落到青石庭院中央。男主背对镜头独自站立，雨水顺着刀鞘不断滴落。二十余名黑衣敌人从四面回廊、山门和屋顶无声出现，形成层层包围。镜头贴近男主右手，他用拇指缓缓顶开刀镡，刀刃露出一线寒光。敌人首领在回廊阴影中低声说道：“拿下。”男主抬起眼睛，平静回答：“让开。”伴随低沉雷声，第一批敌人突然冲出。
15-30秒：四名持短刀敌人从正面和两侧同时夹击。镜头采用贴身手持跟拍，男主侧身避开第一刀，用刀鞘撞开第二人的手腕，反手拔刀格挡第三人的横斩，金属碰撞迸出短促火星。他不做多余动作，连续使用肩撞、肘击、扫腿和刀背重击，将三名敌人迅速击倒。第四名敌人从背后扑来，男主听到脚步声，低头避开刀锋，转身用刀柄击中对方面部，再借对方身体挡住迎面刺来的长枪。镜头绕男主半圈，其他敌人立刻收紧包围，没有停下来等待。
30-45秒：六名长枪敌人组成半圆枪阵，同时向男主逼近，枪尖不断封锁他的退路。男主没有正面硬拼，而是快速退向庭院狭窄石阶，引诱枪阵收缩。第一排长枪同时刺出时，他踩着湿滑石阶侧身滑下，刀锋由下向上连续斩断两根枪杆，随后抓住断裂枪杆向侧面拨打，令另外三支长枪互相碰撞。他踩上一尊倾斜的石狮，借高度越过低扫的枪杆，落下时以膝撞击倒一名枪手。镜头从低角度跟随落地动作，雨水被双脚猛烈溅开。
45-60秒：屋顶上的敌人突然跃下，前后夹击男主。镜头迅速仰拍，两道黑影穿过灯笼和雨幕落向庭院。男主翻身滚过地面，刀锋贴着敌人的靴底掠过，顺势来到回廊入口。他利用廊柱阻挡多人围攻，让敌人无法同时展开。两名敌人一左一右贴近，男主用刀背压住左侧短刀，抬腿踢中右侧敌人的膝弯，再借廊柱反弹转身，将左侧敌人撞进后方人群。一个灯笼被刀锋割断，从空中落下，在积水中熄灭，画面短暂陷入半明半暗。
60-75秒：战斗进入第一次高潮。剩余敌人分成前后两队，在回廊中高速追击男主。镜头采用侧面长距离跟拍，男主一边后退一边格挡连续刀击，刀锋、雨水和火星在画面中交错。他突然踢翻长凳，迫使前排敌人跳跃躲避，自己从长凳下方滑过，起身后连续击中两人的腰腹和手腕。另一名敌人从柱后偷袭，男主用左手抓住对方持刀手臂，将其带向廊柱，迫使刀锋嵌入木柱，再用肩膀将其撞倒。动作紧凑、真实、清晰，不出现无意义旋转。
75-90秒：山门外的弩手突然射击。弩箭穿过雨幕击碎回廊木窗，男主迅速掀起一张木桌作为盾牌。镜头紧贴木桌另一侧，数支弩箭接连穿透桌面，箭头距离男主面部只有几厘米。男主顶着木桌向前冲撞，将两名敌人压倒在台阶上，随后把木桌推向弩手方向，趁遮挡翻滚进入大殿。敌人紧随其后冲进殿内。最后一支弩箭擦过男主左肩，划破衣袖，留下明显但不过度血腥的伤口。从此刻开始，男主左臂活动受到轻微影响，呼吸逐渐沉重。
90-105秒：大殿内部空间狭窄，残破佛像和木柱形成复杂障碍。一个身材魁梧的敌人挥舞铁棍迎面砸下，男主横刀抵挡，却被巨大力量震退，长刀脱手滑到佛像台阶下。魁梧敌人连续挥棍横扫，男主俯身闪避，铁棍击碎木柱表面。男主贴近对方，让长兵器无法发挥，用掌根、肘击和膝撞连续攻击对方胸腹，然后抓住铁棍中段借力旋转，将魁梧敌人摔过肩膀，砸碎旁边长桌。男主没有时间拾刀，只能夺下一根断裂枪杆作为短棍迎敌。
105-120秒：四名敌人在大殿中同时围攻。男主使用断枪进行近身棍法，挡住两把短刀，利用枪杆两端分别打击敌人的手腕、喉前和膝盖。镜头在木柱之间快速横移，通过柱子遮挡完成自然转场。男主故意露出破绽，引诱两名敌人同时进攻，最后一刻侧身闪开，让二人的兵器互相卡住。他用断枪横扫二人腿部，再踩住掉落的短刀，将短刀踢到手中。另一名敌人从佛像上方扑下，男主举起短刀格挡，巨大的冲击让两人同时摔出殿门，重新落入暴雨庭院。
120-135秒：男主在积水中翻滚起身，敌人首领终于从回廊阴影中走出。首领身材高瘦，使用一把带锁链的弯刃，动作冷静而危险。剩余敌人退到四周封锁出口。首领甩动锁链，弯刃贴着地面划过，激起一道水浪。男主连续后退闪避，弯刃缠住他的短刀并猛然拉走。首领第二次甩出锁链，缠住男主脚踝，将他拖倒在湿滑地面。男主在被拖动过程中抓住一块破碎瓦片，割开缠绕脚踝的布带，翻身避开从上方劈落的弯刃。弯刃重重砸进青石地面，火星和雨水同时炸开。
135-150秒：三名剩余敌人趁男主倒地同时冲来。男主已经疲惫，左肩受伤，动作明显不再轻松。他故意保持半跪姿势，引诱第一人靠近，突然抓住对方手腕，将其带入首领再次甩来的锁链轨迹。锁链缠住敌人的兵器，造成短暂混乱。男主利用湿滑地面低身旋转扫腿，使另外两人失去平衡，再用刀鞘和拳肘连续击倒。最后一名敌人试图从背后刺击，男主在积水倒影中看见对方，头也不回地向后撞肘，随后转身用掌根将其击倒。庭院里只剩男主与首领相对而立。
150-165秒：最终决斗。雷声骤然炸响，首领抽回锁链弯刃，发动连续快速攻击。镜头在广角全景和刀锋特写之间切换：弯刃横扫、锁链回旋、男主侧闪、格挡、翻滚，每一次动作都清晰连贯。男主捡回落在庭院边缘的长刀，用刀身缠住锁链，却被首领猛力拉近。两人在极近距离展开拳肘搏斗，首领击中男主伤肩，男主痛苦后退，长刀再次险些脱手。首领高举弯刃完成最后一击时，画面短暂升格，男主没有后退，而是突然向前贴身进入锁链内圈，用护腕架开首领手臂，以刀柄重击其胸口。
165-180秒：恢复正常速度。首领踉跄后退仍想挥刀，男主踩住落在积水中的锁链，旋身夺下弯刃，再用长刀精准架在首领颈侧，动作突然停止。雨声重新变得清晰，首领手中的兵器缓缓掉落，跪倒在地。男主没有补刀，只是收刀入鞘。镜头缓慢拉远，庭院中敌人全部失去战斗能力，兵器散落在雨水里，没有血腥特写。男主扶着受伤的左肩穿过山门，破晓的微光从远处云层后出现。最后一个镜头停留在积水中的刀痕和逐渐平静的波纹上，远处传来男主渐行渐远的脚步声，画面自然淡出。
镜头要求：整段战斗保持明确的空间方向和人物位置，使用大远景交代战场，中近景呈现攻防动作，适量使用贴身手持跟拍、低角度跟拍、环绕移动、遮挡转场和关键动作升格；不要频繁无意义快切，不要让镜头晃动到看不清动作。敌人必须采取包围、夹击、枪阵、远程掩护和多人协同，不能排队等待男主逐个攻击。男主通过地形、廊柱、石阶、长凳、木桌和敌人之间的位置关系化解人数劣势。
声音设计：全程保留真实暴雨声、雷声、急促脚步声、衣料摩擦声、呼吸声、刀剑碰撞声、木材碎裂声和兵器落地声。配乐以前半段低沉鼓点和弦乐持续积累，中段加入快速鼓点，最终决斗时音乐达到高潮；首领跪倒后音乐立刻停止，只保留雨声和脚步声。
禁止出现：仙术、飞行、能量波、武器发光、夸张爆炸、血腥肢解、现代物品、字幕、文字、LOGO和水印；禁止人物脸部突变、服装变化、额外肢体、兵器凭空出现或消失、敌人数量突然增加、同一个敌人重复出现、动作穿模、无重力漂浮、连续无意义空翻以及男主毫发无伤。整段必须像一场真正拍摄完成、叙事清楚、动作连贯、逐步升级的3分钟电影级武打戏。

entries.title: Trojan War Selfie Vlog
entries.text:
Scene and Mood: A modern, camera ready woman films a casual selfie style vlog update while the Trojan War rages in full chaos behind her, her ironic commentary colliding harder and harder against real explosions, smoke, and clashing soldiers until the danger finally cracks her calm.
Frame Map: Shot 1 (0 to 6s), extended arm selfie framing, her face and shoulders fill the left two thirds of frame, x=40%, foreground, chest up. Right third and background hold the smoking battlefield, distant soldiers clashing, burning siege structures. Shot 2 (6 to 14s), same selfie framing, camera whip shakes as a nearby impact throws dust into frame, her face still anchored left center. Shot 3 (14 to 22s), slightly wider selfie angle, x=45%, more of the background battlefield visible behind her right shoulder, chariots cutting across the midground. Shot 4 (22 to 30s), tight selfie close up, x=50%, face fills 70% of frame height, background reduced to a soft focus wash of firelight and smoke.
Subject Lock: Long dark wavy hair, olive skin, sharp contoured features, gold hoop earrings, a dust smudged white linen wrap top, holding a matte black phone at arms length toward her own face throughout. Body angled three quarter toward the lens, weight shifting between feet as the ground shakes. Expression starts polished and bright for camera, cracks into wide eyed reaction at the nearby impact, recovers into a knowing smirk by the close. Free hand touches her hair or braces on nothing as she

entries.title: Victorian Greenhouse and Mechanical Hummingbird
entries.text:
15-second photorealistic cinematic video, 16:9, with synchronized stereo audio.
A female explorer with short black hair, a red waterproof jacket, and a gray backpack remains perfectly consistent inside an abandoned Victorian greenhouse during a nighttime storm.
0–4s: A low-angle tracking shot follows her walking across the wet floor. Her boot hits a puddle, creating a physically accurate splash.
4–8s: Without a cut, the camera moves into a medium side-tracking shot. She pushes aside a wet branch as a brass mechanical hummingbird emerges, circles her head, and casts warm golden light across her face.
8–12s: The camera performs a fluid 120-degree orbit. She extends her hand and the hummingbird lands precisely on her finger. Its wings slow naturally as water droplets fall from its metallic body. She says in Spanish, with natural lip sync: “Así que eras real.”
12–15s: Lightning illuminates the greenhouse. A rapid rack focus reveals an enormous bioluminescent flower opening in the background and releasing glowing blue particles. The explorer and hummingbird turn toward it simultaneously. End with a slow push toward the flower.
35mm anamorphic cinematography, natural depth of field, realistic physics, coherent reflections, detailed skin, blue storm light contrasted with the hummingbird’s golden glow.
Immersive stereo rain, wind, vibrating glass, synchronized footsteps and splashes, spatial mechanical buzzing, clean dialogue, and one deep musical note when the flower opens.
Priorities: absolute character and wardrobe consistency, stable hummingbird design, correct anatomy, natural hands, precise physical contact, coherent movement, consistent lighting, and continuous camera motion. Exactly one explorer and one hummingbird. No subtitles, text, logos, or additional characters.

entries.title: Vietnamese Mythic Creature Epic
entries.text:
[Phần 1: Character]
+ Nhân (young man, @referance image): A rustic Vietnamese peasant with sun-bronzed skin, wearing simple dark linen garments, showing deep resilience and bravery.
+ Hắc Thần Điểu (mythical giant bird @referance image ): A colossal guardian bird of prey with jet-black feathers, a razor-sharp golden beak, and piercing, glowing red eyes.
+ Giao Long (mythical sea monster): Serpentine dragon-like sea creatures covered in dark green scales with vibrant bioluminescent green patterns and glowing eyes.
[Phần 2: Bối cảnh]
An ancient mythical Vietnamese seascape during a raging tempest, dominated by towering limestone karsts rising majestically from a turbulent, bioluminescent green ocean. The environment is devoid of any modern structures, filled only with untamed waters, dark ominous storm clouds, and a mythical atmosphere of a forgotten folkloric era.
[Phần 3: Phong cách đoạn video]
Cinematic 8K video style with hyper-realistic textures and dynamic dark-fantasy atmosphere. The color palette features deep ocean blues, stormy charcoal greys, and dramatic contrast from the vibrant bioluminescent green of the sea creatures and the divine gold energy of the mythical bird. High-speed action cinematography with dramatic slow-motion, dynamic tracking shots, shutter angle matching intense action, organic film grain, and realistic water simulation with volumetric splashes and heavy atmosphere.
[Phần 4: Shot-by-shot]
Shot 1 (2s):
POV moving rapidly upward from deep underwater towards the surface. Looking through the murky, bubbling green water, the glowing silhouettes of giant Giao Long swirl below, creating a sense of thalassophobia. Above the water's surface, the dark silhouette of Hac Than Dieu 📷is visible from behind, flying in place with Nhan r📷iding on its back, his back turned to the camera. Golden hour stormy light filters through the surface. no dialog
Shot 2 (3s):
Close-up of the bubbling, boiling sea surface glowing with an eerie, underwater green bioluminescence under a dark stormy sky. The atmosphere is strangely silent. A colossal, glowing shadow of Giao Long swirls beneath the waves, then suddenly bursts violently upward from the ocean directly towards the camera, spraying water everywhere. no dialog
Shot 3 (1s):
Close-up of Nhan's panicked face under the flashing stormy light, wind whipping his hair. He sits on the back of Hac Than Dieu, quickly turning his head around to look at the newly emerged sea dragon behind them, his eyes wide with fear. Nhan screams "Cẩn thận!" (dialogue in Vietnamese).
Shot 4 (1s):
Close-up of Hac Than Dieu under the stormy sky, its sharp head snapping around in alarm toward the direction Nhan is looking, its red eyes glowing intensely as it senses the threat. no dialog
Shot 5 (2s):
Wide slow-motion tracking shot. Under a dark, stormy sky, the massive Hac Than Dieu, with Nhan clinging to its feathered back, masterfully tilts its giant black wings to the side, narrowly evading the massive Giao Long's snapping jaws in a near-miss aerial dodge. no dialog
Shot 6 (2s):
Slow-motion close-up of Nhan under flashing lightning, his expression filled with sheer terror as the bird tilts sharply. He grips the thick dark feathers of Hac Than Dieu tightly with both hands, trying his best not to fall off into the ocean below. no dialog
Shot 7 (1s):
Slow-motion extreme close-up of the lunging Giao Long's fearsome mouth, filled with sharp, wet fangs and glowing with green light, snapped open wide, attempting to bite the edge of Hac Than Dieu's massive black wing under the stormy sky. no dialog
Shot 8 (2s):
Slow-motion shot of Hac Than Dieu carrying Nhan on its back. The giant bird performs a breathtaking mid-air barrel roll under the dark, thundering clouds, its body twisting elegantly to dodge the attack. no dialog
Shot 9 (4s):
Wide shot showcasing the majestic landscape of jagged limestone karsts rising from the churning ocean. The bioluminescent green water glows intensely as multiple Giao Long rise and fly up. The camera speed ramps back to normal as Hac Than Dieu escapes the first bite spectacularly, swiftly dodging a second lunging Giao Long, while three more of the sea monsters are seen in the background preparing to lunge at high speed. no dialog
Shot 10 (1s):
Close-up of Hac Than Dieu's head under the stormy sky. The giant bird opens its sharp beak wide, letting out a booming, telepathic command. Hac Than Dieu shouts "Bám chặt!" (dialogue in Vietnamese).
Shot 11 (1s):
Close-up of Nhan. Shifting from initial panic to absolute focus, his face hardens with determination as he locks his grip even tighter onto the dark feathers of Hac Than Dieu under the flashing lightning. no dialog
Shot 12 (1s):
Medium shot under the dark stormy twilight. The first Giao Long, frustrated by its missed attack, turns around aggressively and lunges headfirst directly towards the camera, its glowing green eyes filled with rage. no dialog
Shot 13 (9s):
Medium dynamic continuous shot kết hợp với obit shot. Under the dark stormy sky, Hac Than Dieu carrying Nhan releases a brilliant burst of divine golden energy. Suddenly accelerating, the giant bird rolls in mid-air and strikes the lunging Giao Long's head with its powerful talons, knocking it out of the frame. Instantly, a second Giao Long attacks from the side; Hac Than Dieu swerves swiftly, and Nhan uses the momentum to land a powerful kick on the monster's flank, sending it crashing away. Two more Giao Long attack in tandem; a smooth, dynamic orbiting camera tracks Hac Than Dieu as it weaves through their strikes, diving through a narrow, majestic limestone mountain pass over the sea, leading the camera into a pitch black screen. no dialog

entries.title: Window Cleaning Morning Slice of Life
entries.text:
Main Subject:
Young Korean woman, early 20s, natural everyday appearance, oversized faded t-shirt tucked into shorts, hair tied up in a claw clip, minimal makeup, realistic skin texture, cheerful relaxed personality.
Location: Small house window facing a quiet residential alley, mid-morning. Wooden window frame, a bucket of soapy water on the ledge, potted plants nearby, soft sunlight. No commercial elements.
Visual Style: Ultra-realistic documentary realism, unscripted domestic feeling, soft natural morning light.
Camera Style: Early 2000s consumer DV camcorder aesthetic, handheld shake, autofocus hunting between her and the glass reflections, faded soft contrast, mild sensor noise. No stabilization.
Timeline (30 sec):
00:00–00:03 → She dips a cloth into the soapy bucket, then wrings it out over the ledge.
00:03–00:06 → She wipes the window in slow circular motions, streaks of soap catching the light.
00:06–00:09 → She pauses, then says to camera "이거 완전 뿌옇게 됐었어" ("This got really foggy").
00:09–00:12 → She rinses the cloth again, then continues wiping the lower corner of the glass.
00:12–00:15 → She steps back to check her work, tilting her head side to side.
00:15–00:18 → She notices a smudge, then leans in to rub it out more carefully.
00:18–00:21 → She wipes her hands on a towel, then looks at camera saying "이제 깨끗하다" ("It's clean now").
00:21–00:24 → She admires the clear view through the glass, smiling softly.
00:24–00:27 → A light breeze moves the curtain nearby; she glances at it, amused.
00:27–00:30 → She looks at camera saying "다음 창문도 해야지" ("I should do the next window too"), walking off as it fades.
Audio: Cloth squeaking on glass, water dripping, faint birds, distant street sounds. Her dialogue as noted above. No music.
Goal: A quiet, satisfying weekend chore moment grounded, warm, believable.

entries.title: Wuxia Inn Duel Over One Bun
entries.text:
【风格】武侠电影级动作喜剧（Wuxia Action Comedy），古风客栈实景，8K，达芬奇高级调色，升格慢动作与快剪结合，真实布料与木屑物理，横屏16:9
【时长】30秒
【场景】古风江湖客栈大堂，木桌长凳、红灯笼、蒸笼冒热气，梁柱交错，光从窗棂斜射带浮尘
【角色】女侠A @图1（红衣冷艳，用剑）、女侠B @图2（青衣飒爽，用双筷/软鞭），两人武艺相当
[00:00-00:02] 钩子·同时出手
蒸笼掀开——热气散去，只剩孤零零一个白胖包子。两只手"唰"地同时探向它，在包子上方一寸僵住。镜头拉近两人对视，杀气骤起。
音效：蒸汽"嘶"声，一声兵刃出鞘。
[00:02-00:06] 拔剑·桌面开打
A拔剑挑翻整张桌子腾空，B踩着飞起的长凳跃上房梁，包子被气浪震到空中。碗筷茶壶四散飞溅。
[00:06-00:11] 空中争夺（升格）
包子在半空划弧，两人凌空交手，A剑尖挑、B筷子夹，包子在刀光间被抢来抢去，谁也没碰实，热气还在包子上冒。
[00:11-00:16] 客栈大乱
战场蔓延，两人踩桌翻梁、灯笼被削落、木屑纷飞，其他"食客"抱头躲桌下。包子始终在两人争夺中心悬着不落。
[00:16-00:21] 决胜一击（升格特写）
A与B同时使出绝招，剑气与鞭影在包子两侧交汇——包子被劲气托着高高弹起，两人各自摆出接杀造型，屏息等它落下。
[00:21-00:26] 神反转
镜头跟着下落的包子——一只慵懒的橘猫"喵"地从桌上跃起，在半空一口叼住包子，稳稳落地，当着两人的面吧唧吧唧吃完，舔爪。
音效：所有打斗音效戛然而止，一声"喵~"，乌鸦飞过。
[00:26-00:30] 傻眼收尾（定格）
A和B保持着帅气的接杀姿势僵在原地，剑和筷子还举着，齐刷刷看向吃饱打嗝的猫，表情裂开。
字幕（砸出）：「有些仗，打赢了也没用。」
音效：一记喜剧"咚"，猫满足地打了个嗝。
【导演备注】1.反差铁律：打斗越是天崩地裂、招式越华丽正经，最后被猫截胡的落差越好笑；2.身份锁定：A=@图1红衣用剑、B=@图2青衣用筷/鞭，脸/服装全程一致；3.节奏：2秒对峙→拔剑→空中争夺→大乱→决胜→猫反转，动作段用快剪+关键处升格；4.物理真实：包子热气、木屑、灯笼、布料惯性、猫的重量都要真实，武侠不卡通；5.包子必须全程在画面中心被争夺，是视觉焦点和笑点核心；6.不见血、不伤人，纯招式对拆。
【负面提示词】卡通武侠，塑料CG，换脸，两人身份/武器混淆，包子中途消失，猫出现得太早，血腥伤人，多余手指，字幕提前，水印，真实品牌logo，画面糊乱，未成年人形象。

entries.title: WWI Dogfight with Layered Cinematography
entries.text:
【30 秒一战空战 严格分层镜头版提示词（逐镜头标注摄影参数 + 前景 / 中景 / 背景三层光影，防过拟合）
30 秒高镜头密度一战空中格斗完整故事线，激烈战场硝烟氛围，一战高空漫天混战场景，超大画幅宽银幕，粗颗粒复古胶片质感，黄褐色复古战场影调，21:9 宽银幕，画面全程动态流畅无卡顿，每一个镜头严格区分前景 / 中景 / 背景三层景深，前后景焦距完全不同，杜绝平面前后景同焦画面，彻底避免 AI 过拟合同质化效果。德国双翼战机
￼
德国战机2
，英国双翼战机
￼
英国战机
，德军飞行员
￼
德飞行员
，英国飞行员
￼
英飞行员
。
0-2s：大远景高空俯视 焦距：14mm 光圈：f/5.6。前景：浓密高空硝烟缓慢流动擦过镜头下缘；中景：两架主角双翼战机（德方战机
￼
德国战机2
在后，英方战机在前
￼
英国战机
）一起在云缝里高速俯冲，后机死死咬住前机尾后；背景：数十架一战士战机群在远方天空各处缠斗，拉出密密麻麻白色航迹，厚重铅灰色积云铺满整个天空。自然光硬侧光，光线从侧上方斜切下来，硝烟边缘被阳光打透成半透明金色。
2-4s：驾驶舱中景跟拍 焦距：75mm 光圈：f/2.0。前景：螺旋桨转动拉出动态模糊气流从镜头前扫过；中景：德方飞行员
￼
德飞行员
坐在驾驶舱里猛推操纵杆，头盔风镜反射出前方英方战机轮廓；背景：战机帆布蒙皮机身结构、高空远处模糊的云团轮廓层次虚化。侧逆光打亮飞行员肩线，驾驶舱内部保留暗部细节，浅景深背景完全虚化。
4-7s：机身侧面跟拍中近景 焦距：50mm 光圈：f/2.8。前景：高速气流卷动机翼蒙布线头抖动擦过画面边缘；中景：两架飞机机翼几乎贴在一起，德方战机机枪口连续喷吐出枪口焰，亮白色曳光弹线条连续擦过英方战机机翼蒙皮表面；背景：远处空中其他战机开火的微弱枪口焰光点零散分布在硝烟里。侧顶硬光，机枪开火瞬间枪口焰在机身蒙皮上投下跳动的光斑。
7-10s：机翼破口大特写 焦距：180mm 光圈：f/1.4。前景：飞溅的金属蒙皮碎屑在镜头前景慢动作划过；中景：英方战机机翼表面被机枪子弹击中，帆布蒙皮撕开破口漏出内部钢丝骨架，缕缕白烟从破口处冒出来；背景：远处蓝天和云层被浅景深完全虚化成柔和色块。侧光精准打亮破口边缘撕裂的帆布纤维纹理，暗部保留阴影层次，极致浅景深。
10-13s：飞行员近景特写 焦距：85mm 光圈：f/1.8。前景：高速气流吹动飞行服领口在画面左下角微微晃动；中景：英方飞行员猛拉杆回头看向后方，脸上紧绷全神贯注，快速扳动操纵杆做极限规避动作；背景：驾驶舱风窗外飞速流过的云层完全虚化。侧光半打亮飞行员半张脸，另一半落在硬朗阴影里，浅景深背景完全模糊，突出人物紧绷情绪。
13-17s：极限规避低角度环绕镜头 焦距：24mm 光圈：f/4。前景：地面炸起的橙色硝烟烟尘从画面底部向上翻涌；中景：英方战机侧身几乎 90 度侧翻，大角度转向从德方战机射击窗口里快速滑脱，机翼下方掠过地面一战战壕铁丝网轮廓；背景：远方地平线处数十个地面炸开的硝烟烟柱缓缓升起。侧逆光把战机机身勾出完整金色轮廓，低角度让机身在天空里极具冲击力，中景深只把机身主体拍实，远景硝烟层次自然虚化。
17-21s：高空拉升大远景 焦距：20mm 光圈：f/8。前景：半透明硝烟云团从镜头前缓缓飘过；中景：两架主角飞机一追（德方战机）一绕（英方战机）在高空云团里拉出交叉的白烟轨迹；背景：整片天空布满上百条战斗机拉出的白色航迹线，无数小黑点大小的战机在远景各处互相厮杀，庞大混乱的一战空战战场全貌完整铺开。顶光漫射下硝烟层次丰富，大景深完整收纳前景中景背景三层全部清晰的战场空间，画面纵深感拉满。
21-24s：迎头对冲低角度仰拍 焦距：35mm 光圈：f/2.8。前景：两架飞机高速旋转的螺旋桨扇叶边缘虚化形成动态扇面；中景：双机同时迎头对冲相向飞行，机身快速向镜头逼近，距离飞速缩短；背景：后方整片高空混战的机群轮廓全部虚化散焦。正仰拍逆光，机身被阳光完全勾勒出黑色剪影，只透出机翼轮廓的半透明帆布纹理，前景螺旋桨动态模糊增加速度感。
24-27s：隔舱对视大特写 焦距：100mm 光圈：f/1.4。前景：驾驶舱风窗外晃动的气流波纹虚化在镜头前；中景：两名飞行员隔着呼啸气流在驾驶舱里互相对视一瞬，时间微微放慢；背景：两侧飞速向后流走的天空和云团完全虚化成运动模糊拖影。侧软光只打亮两名飞行员半张脸，背景极致虚化，浅景深把所有注意力锁在人物眼神对视的瞬间。
27-29s：贴脸擦身极高速跟拍 焦距：40mm 光圈：f/3.5。前景：机翼尖擦过的气流扰动在画面边缘形成动态扭曲波纹；中景：两架战机几乎贴脸擦肩而过，机翼尖差几厘米就会相撞，气流吹动机翼表面蒙布剧烈抖动；背景：两侧向后飞速退去的混战战机全部拉出动态运动拖影。追焦跟拍全程只有两架主角战机机身完全锐利，前后运动物体全部带自然运动模糊，速度感拉满。
29-30s：两机反向散开收束大远景 焦距：21mm 光圈：f/5.6。前景：最后一缕高空硝烟缓缓从画面中间飘过；中景：两架反向飞远的双翼机背对着彼此向天空两个方向散开，身后留下两道漫长的白烟航迹，黄昏阳光把机身轮廓镀上一层金边；背景：远方天空仍在持续厮杀的整个战场，漫天航迹和硝烟构成庞大的一战空战史诗全景。黄昏暖橙色侧逆光斜照整个画面，烟的边缘是金的，云层底部是暖橙色，远处战场硝烟带着冷蓝灰调，冷暖对比宽银幕史诗感拉满。
全局约束：全程动作节奏紧凑激烈，一战战机细节完全写实，没有任何现代喷气式飞机，无多余字幕无多余文字，胶片颗粒均匀自然，所有镜头的光圈焦距参数对应生成正确景深分层，严格杜绝前后景同焦平面的扁平化画面，完全避免过拟合 AI 同质化效果。镜头要自然，不要生硬。】全片不要有音乐，不要有文字。

entries.title: Y2K Pop Duo Music Video
entries.text:
**[SCENE]** A two-member female pop duo shoots a retro Y2K-style music video: candy-colored studio sets, tightly synchronized hand choreography, beat-locked hard cuts and fast punch zooms — the texture of 1999 music television, rendered at modern production quality.
**[ACTIVE REFERENCES]**
<<<image_1>>>: Female singer in her twenties, long straight pink hair with gold hair clips, small nose ring, beauty mark on cheek, white printed crop top, silver chain necklace, chain belt, light-blue washed baggy jeans, off-white platform sneakers. Playful and confident. 100% match to reference image.
<<<image_2>>>: Female singer in her twenties, long straight black hair with silver hair clips, light blue eyes with silver glitter eyeshadow, red cord necklace with ruby pendant, gray raglan short-sleeve tee with a gray jacket draped over the shoulders, dark gray pleated skirt with bow, gray knee socks, black platform shoes. Cool and commanding. 100% match to reference image.
**[SET MAP]** Three practical studio sets, each roughly 4 meters deep, facing camera:
Set A — bubblegum-pink seamless cyclorama, glossy reflective floor, two rows of round studio light bulbs on the back wall.
Set B — cobalt-blue seamless cyclorama, a single hard white spotlight circle on the floor.
Set C — floor-to-ceiling silver rain-strand curtain wall, mirrored floor.
**[FIRST FRAME & SPATIAL LAYOUT]** The first visible frame already contains both girls, on Set A: <<<image_1>>> at frame-left x40%, <<<image_2>>> at right x60%, medium-shot depth, 0.5 m apart, bodies squared to camera, eyes locked on lens, frozen in a mirrored opening pose — inner hand on hip, outer arm raised. No empty establishing shot, no delayed entrance.
**[FORMAT]** Controlled multi-shot sequence, seven segments across 15 seconds, every hard cut landing precisely on a musical downbeat. Real-time motion.
**[LENS NOTES]** Fisheye = true fisheye wide-angle, 1.5 m from subject, visible barrel distortion at frame edges, deliberate 1999 MV lens language; 47° = standard view, natural proportions; 29° = medium-tele portrait, background lightly compressed; 18° = long-lens close-up, melted bokeh. Locked within each segment, no drift.
**[ACTION TIMELINE]**
0.0–2.0s Set A, fisheye low angle: both hit the frozen mirrored pose on beat one, then bounce-groove in sync with every beat, camera slowly pushes in 10%.
Hard cut at 2.0s. 2.0–4.0s Set B, 29°: <<<image_2>>> solo dance inside the spotlight circle at x50%, pointed-at-camera precision hand choreography, one fast punch zoom landing exactly on the downbeat.
Hard cut at 4.0s. 4.0–6.0s Set C, 47°: <<<image_1>>> whips her pink hair through a full arc, then strides toward camera as the camera pulls back at matched speed, rain-strand curtain shimmering, chain belt swinging.
Hard cut at 6.0s. 6.0–8.0s Set B, 18° two-shot close-up: both faces cheek-to-cheek filling the frame, <<<image_1>>> left / <<<image_2>>> right, soft wind lifting pink and black strands, glossy makeup, confident smiles, heads tilting toward each other in sync with the beat.
Hard cut at 8.0s. 8.0–11.0s Set A, 47° full body: the chorus dance core — three counts of fully synchronized choreography: wave arms, fast spin, full-body groove into a sharp freeze; positions cross and return, <<<image_1>>> left / <<<image_2>>> right re-locked.
Hard cut at 11.0s. 11.0–13.0s Set C, 47°: the two walk toward camera side by side with synchronized arm swings, black and pink hair swinging with each step, reflections in the mirrored floor.
Hard cut at 13.0s. 13.0–15.0s Set A, 47°: back-to-back frozen final pose, camera zooms out fast to full body, landing exactly on the last downbeat, one bright camera-flash white sweep over the final frame.
**[PHYSICS]** Choreography carries real weight: heel strikes, weight shifts, shoulder isolations with follow-through. Hair whips show visible lag and settle naturally. Chain belt and necklaces swing on the beat points. Rain-strand curtain ripples from body movement. Glossy floor returns soft, believable reflections.
**[LIGHTING]** High-key, even studio lighting on every set: large soft frontal key, bright clean exposure, high skin sheen; Set A's bulb rows create back rim light and soft bloom into the lens; Set B's spotlight casts a crisp circular pool; Set C sparkles with hundreds of rain-strand specular highlights. Bright, candy-like, camera-ready — a deliberate flat 1999 broadcast-TV look.
**[AUDIO]** Original Y2K bubblegum dance-pop instrumental, 120 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, bright syncopated synths, faint tape hiss underneath. Every hard cut lands exactly on a downbeat. Instrumental only throughout, no vocals; both girls perform with closed lips, delivering energy purely through expression and choreography.
**[POSITIVE LOCKS]** Both faces and identities 100% locked to reference images across all segments including close-ups. Wardrobe stays exactly as referenced across all three sets. Only these two girls appear in the entire video. In every two-person segment <<<image_1>>> is fixed frame-left, <<<image_2>>> fixed frame-right. Within each segment, set geography, spacing, and screen direction stay consistent.
**[STYLE]** Shot at modern production quality but graded to 1999 broadcast texture: broadcast-grade videotape master grain layered over high-detail imagery — soft highlight bloom, slight chroma bleed on hard color edges, fine analog tape grain, faint interlace flicker on fast motion; a high-saturation candy palette of bubblegum pink, electric cobalt and chrome silver; Y2K music-television punch-zoom editing energy, with contemporary sharpness preserved underneath.

entries.title: Youth Racing Anime Film
entries.text:
A 30-second cinematic youth-racing story short, 2D animation style. The protagonist is a teenage rider, racing a motorcycle in a high-level competition. The overall style is hot-blooded, youthful, emotionally intense, and strongly cinematic, with a complete dramatic structure and a clear emotional arc. The whole film uses only two camera moves: high-speed tracking and slow-motion orbit. Dialogue is minimal, appearing naturally like fragments of memory, the tone sincere, gentle, and restrained, no slogans, no over-sentimentality. No sense of disaster, no negative expression, no exaggerated sci-fi. The focus is on the love, support, fight-back, and growth within youthful racing.
0s to 5s: A dusk racetrack, a high-speed intense racing opening. The camera hugs the ground in high-speed tracking of the teen's motorcycle, tires grazing the track's edge line, the bike roaring, the wind sharp, the atmosphere tense and fervent. The teen is fully focused, the setting sun drawing sharp highlights across the bike's metal shell.
5s to 9s: After entering a key corner, the teen is suddenly overtaken by a rival. The high-speed tracking keeps pushing forward, the image conveying the pressure of a dropping rank and a disrupted rhythm. A close-up inside the helmet shows a brief daze, tightening breath, slight wavering. The teen says quietly: "Can I still catch up..."
9s to 14s: The teen falls behind, breathing heavier, his emotions sinking into a low point. The race doesn't stop, the bike still racing forward at high speed. The image begins to flash back to warm memory fragments amid the high-speed riding: as a child learning to ride, someone steadying him from behind; his father adjusting his helmet, the motion careful and quiet; before the finish line, a gentle smile watching him; on a dusk slope, the silhouettes of figures walking side by side. These memories are all presented with golden backlight, soft slow motion, and a fragmented feel.
14s to 18s: The music gradually turns from oppressive to uplifting. Restrained, gentle voices come from the memories: "Don't be afraid - I'm always here." "Stay steady. And look forward." The teen's gaze refocuses, his breathing slowly steadying, his emotions shifting from wavering to resolute.
18s to 23s: The teen regains his belief, accelerating with all his strength, fighting back with precise cornering lines. The high-speed tracking conveys the power and control of the bike leaning into the corner, exiting the corner, and closing in on the lead car. The teen says quietly but firmly: "I won't stop here."
23s to 27s: Ahead appears a rising stretch of track, the teen sprinting at full speed into the setting sun. The image keeps only the sound of breathing, the engine, and the continuously rising music, with no more extra dialogue. The bike launches into the air on its momentum, entering a stunning slow motion. From deep in his memory comes one last gentle voice with a smile: "Go on."
27s to 30s: The camera makes a slow-motion orbiting close-up around the airborne bike, pushing the hot-blooded, gentle, free, soaring-upward emotion to its climax. Flowers bloom behind in a special effect, then "seedance" appears, see [reference image 1].
